question: Plan A costs 20 yuan per month + 0.1 yuan/minute, while Plan B costs 0 yuan per month + 0.2 yuan/minute. For how many minutes of calls will the costs be equal? (Unit: minutes)
solution: Let the call duration be \(t\) minutes. Then \(20+0.1t=0.2t\), giving \(0.1t=20\) and \(t=200\).

solutionMethods.explanation:
Plan A charges 20 yuan more in fixed fees but saves \(0.2-0.1=0.1\) yuan on each minute of calls. The costs are equal when those savings cover the 20-yuan fee, so the required call duration is
\[
20\div0.1=200\text{ minutes}.
\]
